title: Hydraulic SpeedBreaker — IIC Regional-Level Project
description: An AI-driven smart speed breaker designed to identify approaching ambulances using vision models and sensor fusion, then control a hydraulic mechanism to support emergency vehicle movement.

title: Proxi-Brake
description: An IoT-based automatic braking prototype that uses ultrasonic sensors to detect rear obstacles and trigger braking for accident prevention.

title: Gas Leak Detector
description: A gas leakage detection system using an MQ2 sensor and ESP32 to trigger alerts through Ntfy.

title: Text Analyzer — International Hackathon
description: A text-analysis project designed to identify selected text within a provided group of text.
